value.name: Asha records status questions
value.description: Asha writes on a legal pad while quietly asking the clerk for the man's current status.
evidence: Asha wrote them across the legal pad in the cramped print she used for depositions
she asked, quiet and even, for his current status—conscious, restrained, medicated, transferred out—any of the words the clerk was allowed to say

value.name: Rosa presses for immediate updates
value.description: Asha receives repeated instructions from Rosa to confirm the address, contact name, and immediate status without delay.
evidence: The phone buzzed against her jaw with Rosa's name again: address confirmed, push for the contact name and immediate status, no gaps
The phone buzzed once more against Asha's jaw with Rosa's name—contact and status now, no delays, clear the board before they hit the stairs

value.name: Claire withdraws from the conversation
value.description: Claire silently pulls her hand back into her lap and lets Asha take over the written notes and phone exchange.
evidence: Claire watched the pen move and did not ask what was being written; she only drew her hand back from the table into her lap, as though whatever was on the pad now belonged to Asha to carry
Claire's hand was still folded into her lap

value.name: Child stirs upstairs
value.description: A floorboard shifts upstairs, signaling a child turning over in bed while the adults continue their tense call.
evidence: Upstairs a floorboard shifted, the small dry sound of a child turning over in bed
Upstairs the floorboard settled back into

value.name: Asha keeps questioning the clerk
value.description: Asha continues speaking in a controlled low voice, asking for the contact person's name and the man's condition.
evidence: When the clerk's line opened again she kept her voice at the same low pitch, asking for the name of the contact person on file and whatever the clerk was allowed to say about his condition right now: conscious, restrained, sedated, anything

value.name: Claire reads Asha's word choice
value.description: Claire notices Asha say 'sedated' and takes her lack of reaction as a meaningful answer.
evidence: she watched Asha's mouth shape the word sedated and did not flinch, which was its own kind of answer
